champion.name: Industry Diffusion + Weekly Low-MAX
champion.clock: exact frozen weekly decision close and next-legal-open entry
champion.holding: exact frozen 20-session lifecycle and QD-010 execution

positive_industry_breadth.name: POSITIVE_INDUSTRY_BREADTH
positive_industry_breadth.industry_universe: industries represented by at least one PIT-valid causal daily row at the frozen decision close
positive_industry_breadth.industry_return: equal-weight mean causal stock step_return within each date's PIT industry membership, compounded over the 20 completed sessions ending at the decision close
positive_industry_breadth.timestamp: frozen weekly decision close; no subsequent bar enters
positive_industry_breadth.missing: exclude an industry from numerator and denominator unless all 20 industry daily returns are finite; fail the decision if fewer than 50 complete industries
positive_industry_breadth.normalization: none; absolute fraction of complete industries with strictly positive compounded return

states.threshold_method: fixed economic thirds frozen before outcomes

phase_a_gate_all_required.monotonic_full: LOW < MEDIUM < HIGH mean cohort net payoff

overlay.authorization: run only if every Phase-A gate passes
overlay.scope: scale only new cohort capital using the state known at its frozen signal close; existing cohorts retain their original capital and lifecycle
overlay.selection: identical frozen stocks, weights within each invested cohort, lifecycle, and execution

classification.OPPORTUNITY_HEALTH_NOT_USEFUL: Phase A fails; no overlay replay
classification.CHRONOLOGICALLY_UNSTABLE: Phase A relationship reverses across broad blocks
classification.OPPORTUNITY_HEALTH_OVERLAY_EARNS_COMPLEX: Phase A passes, losing-year arithmetic return improves at least 3 pp, maximum drawdown improves at least 2 pp, Sharpe or Calmar improves at least 0.05, and profitable-year sacrifice per 1 pp loss avoided is at most 1.5
classification.USEFUL_BUT_TOO_COSTLY_IN_UPSIDE: Phase A passes and losing-year return plus drawdown improve, but the risk-adjusted or opportunity-cost gate fails
classification.OVERLAY_DEGRADES_CHAMPION: Phase A passes but losing-year return or maximum drawdown does not improve

prohibited: 2018, 2022, known losing dates, future strategy returns, or hindsight labels in feature construction
market MA, volatility, stock breadth, dispersion, index, macro, candidate breadth, or Low-MAX feature
threshold, horizon, exposure mapping, or allocation grid search
admission veto, Top-N change, exit change, stock-selection change, or total-existing-exposure rewrite
OOS, independent-validation, live, or production claim
